Aguas, agua. Siempre plural en hebreo. S: Waters, water. Always plural in Hebrew. A symbol of primordial chaos and also of life and purification. Central to creation and the exodus.
Amar — decir, hablar, mandar. El verbo m: Amar — to say, speak, command. The most frequent verb in the OT along with 'to be.' 'And God said' marks each creative act. God's word has performative power — what he says happens.
Amor, afecto profundo. Incluye amor fami: Love, deep affection. Includes family love, romantic love, and God's love for his people. The basis of the central commandment: you shall love YHWH with all your heart.
Barak — bendecir, arrodillarse. La bendi: Barak — to bless, to kneel. Divine blessing is the flow of God's life toward his creation. God blessed the seventh day. The Abrahamic blessings reach all nations.
Bavel — Babilonia/Babel, lugar de confus: Bavel — Babylon/Babel, place of confusion. Tower of Babel: human pride vs. divine sovereignty. The empire that destroyed the Temple and carried Israel into exile. In Revelation it symbolizes the world system that opposes God.
Bendito sea YHWH, que cada día nos colma: Blessed be YHWH, who daily bears our burdens.
Bo — entrar, venir, llegar. La entrada a: Bo — to enter, come, arrive. The entry into the promised land under Joshua. Yeshua enters Jerusalem in triumph. The Spirit enters believers. A movement of drawing near and fulfillment.
Buenas nuevas, evangelio. En el mundo ro: Good News, gospel. In the Roman world, the 'gospel' was the announcement of the emperor's birth or victory. Paul uses the term for the announcement of God's Kingdom.
Cielos, firmamento. Plural dual — 'las d: Heavens, firmament. Dual plural — 'the two waters' or 'there the waters.' God's dwelling and the place of the stars. Always plural in Hebrew.
Corazón, mente, voluntad. En hebreo el c: Heart, mind, will. In Hebrew the heart (lev) is the center of the will and reason — not of the emotions. Loving God 'with all your lev' means with all your will.
Cuando pases por las aguas, yo estaré co: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you.
Dikaiosis — declaración de justicia, jus: Dikaiosis — declaration of righteousness, justification. A legal term: the judge declares the accused innocent. God justifies the believing sinner not by his works but by the imputed righteousness of Yeshua. Central in Romans.
Edén, deleite, placer. El jardín donde D: Eden, delight, pleasure. The garden where God placed man. A root related to delight and abundance. A model of the original shalom between God and man.
Ekklēsía — the called-out ones, the assembly. Translated 'church,' but its sense is the community of believers called to be the King's people. The Greek equivalent of the Hebrew 'qahal.'
El Espíritu mismo da testimonio a nuestr: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of YHWH.
El amor nunca deja de ser; pero las prof: Love never fails; but where there are prophecies, they will be done away with.

Esta es la confianza que tenemos en él:: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
Ets — árbol, madera. El árbol de la vida: Ets — tree, wood. The tree of life (ets ha-ḥayyim) is a central symbol. It reappears in Revelation 22 — the tree of life in the New Jerusalem.
Fe, fidelidad, confianza. No es mera cre: Faith, faithfulness, trust. Not mere intellectual belief but active trust and faithfulness. Abraham's faith was 'emunah' — active faithfulness to God's call.
Fíate de YHWH con todo tu corazón, y no: Trust in YHWH with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding.
Geulá — redención, rescate por pariente: Geulah — redemption, rescue by a close relative. The goel (redeemer) pays the price to free a relative from slavery. Boaz as Ruth's goel is a type of the Messiah. YHWH is Israel's Goel.
Guf — cuerpo físico. La Biblia no divide: Guf — physical body. The Bible doesn't divide the human being into body/soul like Greek philosophy. The human being IS a living body. The resurrection is bodily, not only spiritual — God redeems the whole body.
Gustad, y ved que es bueno YHWH; dichoso: Oh taste and see that YHWH is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Hafṭará — porción de los profetas. Lectu: Hafṭarah — portion from the prophets. A reading from the Prophets (Nevi'im) that accompanies each parashah. There is always a thematic connection with the Torah portion. In the Messianic community, a Hafṭarah from the Brit Hadashah is added.
Hijitos míos, os escribo estas cosas par: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have an Advocate.

Jata — pecar, errar el blanco, fallar. L: Jata — to sin, to miss the mark, to fail. The image is an archer who misses the target. Sin is straying from God's purpose for human life.
Jehová es mi luz y mi salvación; ¿de qui: YHWH is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear?
La paz os dejo, mi paz os doy; no como e: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you.

Lev — corazón-mente, centro del ser. En: Lev — heart-mind, the center of one's being. In Hebrew, the heart is where one thinks, decides, and wills. 'Be transformed by the renewing of your mind' (Rom 12:2) is renewing the lev. The New Covenant writes the Torah on the heart.

Lámpara es a mis pies tu palabra, y lumb: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Mas la misericordia de YHWH es desde la: But YHWH's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him.
Mas los que esperan en YHWH tendrán nuev: But those who wait for YHWH will renew their strength.
Mashíaḥ — Mesías. Los reyes y sacerdotes: Mashíaḥ — Messiah. Kings and priests were anointed with oil. The Messiah is the ultimate Anointed One who fulfills the three offices: prophet, priest, and king.
Mashíaḥ — Ungido. El que recibe aceite d: Mashíaḥ — Anointed One. The one who receives the oil of consecration for a special mission: king, priest, or prophet. The awaited Messiah is God's ultimate Anointed One.
Mi Señor, mi Maestro. Título de autorida: My Lord, my Master. A title of authority and sovereignty. Jews read 'Adonai' in place of the Tetragrammaton YHWH out of reverence. It indicates a relationship of obedience and devotion to the sovereign God.
Midbar — desierto, lugar de pastoreo, lu: Midbar — wilderness, a place of pasture, a place where one speaks. A space of testing and spiritual formation. Israel was formed for 40 years in the wilderness. Yeshua was tempted 40 days. A place of intimate encounter with God.
Mitsrayim — Egipto, lugar de la esclavit: Mitsrayim — Egypt, the place of slavery and the exodus. A biblical symbol of the world and slavery to sin. The deliverance from Egypt is the type of all redemption. Hosea 11:1 is quoted in Matt 2:15 about Yeshua.
Moed — tiempo señalado, fiesta, cita. La: Moed — appointed time, feast, appointment. The feasts of Lev 23 are 'moedim' — God's appointments with his people. They aren't Jewish feasts but 'my feasts,' says YHWH. Each moed is a prophetic rehearsal of the redemptive plan.
Mundo, orden, universo. Juan 3:16: Dios: World, order, universe. John 3:16: God loved the kosmos. Not only the planet but humanity as a whole and the created order. Sometimes it contrasts with the Kingdom of God.
Nevuá — profecía, mensaje profético. No: Nevuah — prophecy, prophetic message. It is not mainly prediction of the future but God's Word spoken to the present. The messianic prophecies are the common thread that joins the OT with the NT.
No nos cansemos, pues, de hacer bien; po: Let's not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don't give up.
No os ha sobrevenido ninguna tentación q: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. YHWH is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able.
No temas, porque yo estoy contigo; no de: Don't be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God.
Oscuridad, tinieblas. Opuesto a la luz d: Darkness, gloom. The opposite of divine light. It represents chaos, evil, and the absence of God. Separated from the light at creation.
Pacto — la relación de lealtad mutua est: Covenant — the relationship of mutual loyalty established by God. All the biblical covenants point to the Brit Hadashah (New Covenant) of Jeremiah 31 and Hebrews 8.
Palabra, razón, discurso. En Juan 1:1 id: Word, reason, discourse. In John 1:1 it identifies the Messiah as the eternal Word of God. The Logos is not just communication — it is the complete expression of God made flesh.
Palal — orar, interceder, juzgar. La ora: Palal — to pray, intercede, judge. Prayer as the act of placing oneself under God's judgment and grace. Moses' intercession is a model of prayer that changes a people's destiny.
Parousia — presencia, llegada, venida de: Parousia — presence, arrival, coming of the King. In the Greco-Roman world it was the official visit of a dignitary or king to a city. The return of Yeshua as King of kings to establish his eternal kingdom.
Pará­shá — sección, porción. Las porcion: Parashah — section, portion. The weekly Torah portions. The annual reading cycle begins with Bereshit (fall) and ends with Vezot HaBerakhah. It unites the worldwide community in the same reading.
Paz completa — el estado de plenitud y b: Complete peace — the state of wholeness and well-being for which we were created. A Hebrew greeting and also the final destiny of restored creation.
Pecado, ofrenda por el pecado. La raíz s: Sin, sin offering. The root means to miss the mark. Sin is straying from God's way. The sin offering (chatat) points to the Messiah's atonement.
Pecados — errar el blanco de lo que Dios: Sins — missing the mark of what God designed. The sin offering (chatat) in the Levitical system points to the Messiah's ultimate sacrifice.
Pedid, y se os dará; buscad, y hallaréis: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Porque de tal manera amó YHWH al mundo,: For YHWH so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son.
Porque las montañas se moverán, y los co: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you.
Porque yo sé los planes que tengo para v: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says YHWH, thoughts of peace, and not of evil.
Raah — ver, percibir, comprender. 'Y vio: Raah — to see, perceive, understand. 'And God saw that it was good' — divine approval of creation. The God who sees (El Roi) is the God who perceives his people's suffering.
Reino, reinado, soberanía. El 'Reino de: Kingdom, reign, sovereignty. The 'Kingdom of God' is the central theme of Yeshua's teaching. Not only a future place — God's active reign that has already begun and will be completed.
Shaja — postrarse, adorar, inclinarse. L: Shaja — to bow down, worship, bend low. Biblical worship involves a bodily posture of total submission. The magi bowed down before the child Yeshua. True worship is a response to God's revelation.
Shalom — paz, plenitud, bienestar comple: Shalom — peace, wholeness, complete well-being. Much more than the absence of conflict. It implies integrity, completeness, and the flourishing of all creation in its original purpose.
Shemitá — año de descanso, año de libera: Shemitah — year of rest, year of release. Every 7 years the land rests and debts are canceled. An image of the rest God provides and the freedom the Messiah brings.
Si confesamos nuestros pecados, él es fi: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins.
Sión — montaña de Dios, Jerusalén celest: Zion — God's mountain, the heavenly Jerusalem. The mount where David established his throne and Solomon the Temple. The prophets proclaim that God reigns from Zion. In the NT it is an image of the heavenly community.
Sucot — Cabañas/Tabernáculos. Fiesta de: Sukkot — Booths/Tabernacles. The feast of the final harvest. A memorial of divine protection in the wilderness. Many scholars propose that Yeshua was born during Sukkot. The feast still awaiting final fulfillment.
Sucot — Tabernáculos, Cabañas. Fiesta de: Sukkot — Tabernacles, Booths. The feast of the final harvest and a memorial of the wilderness journey. Many scholars believe Yeshua was born at Sukkot. The last great feast to be fulfilled.
Synagogé — asamblea, lugar de reunión. I: Synagogé — assembly, meeting place. A Jewish institution of study and prayer that arose during the exile. Yeshua and Paul regularly taught in the synagogues. The basis of the model of the Christian ekklesia.
Tierra, suelo, país, nación. Uno de los: Earth, ground, land, nation. One of the most frequent nouns in the OT. It can refer to the planet, a specific territory, or the ground itself.

Tsedaqá — justicia, rectitud, generosida: Tsedaqah — righteousness, justice, generosity. Broader than legal justice. It includes helping the poor, being faithful to the covenant, and living in relational righteousness. God imputes it to the believer.
Vida eterna (zōē aiṓnios) — la vida de l: Eternal life (zōē aiṓnios) — the life of the Messianic Age. It begins now for the believer, not only after death. John 17:3: knowing God is eternal life.
Y mi Dios proveerá a todas vuestras nece: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Yeshua.
Y sabemos que a los que aman a YHWH, tod: We know that all things work together for good for those who love YHWH.
YHWH is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
YHWH peleará por vosotros, y vosotros es: YHWH will fight for you, and you shall be still.

Yaréaj — luna, mes lunar. El calendario: Yareach — moon, lunar month. The biblical calendar is based on the moon. The new moon (Rosh Chodesh) marks the start of each month. The feasts are calculated by the lunar cycle, not the Gregorian solar one.
Yasha — salvar, rescatar, librar. Raíz d: Yasha — to save, rescue, deliver. The root of the name Yeshua. YHWH is Israel's Savior. Salvation always comes from God, never from human effort.
Zevaḥ — sacrificio, ofrenda. La ofrenda: Zevaḥ — sacrifice, offering. The offering shared in a sacred meal with God. Root: to slaughter in order to offer. The basis of the sacrificial system that points to the ultimate sacrifice.
